title: Unify auth interfaces: add SessionFactory and lightweight stream helpers
author: Liam Ortiz
release_notes: Add SessionFactory to Go SDK, expose compact stream helpers, improve telemetry hooks and auth retry presets. Backcompatible for most consumers; small opt-in API surface for advanced session orchestration.
description: Summary: Introduces a SessionFactory abstraction in the Go SDK to harmonize credential lifecycle and to make cross-sdk session semantics parity with the Py/TS SDKs. Adds lightweight stream helpers (StreamReader, PullIterator) to simplify pull-style streaming ergonomics, and exposes telemetry hooks for credential events. Motivation: customer work (SUP-3321) surfaced inconsistent session control between language SDKs which made implementing transparent credential handoffs and prefetching brittle. This PR centralizes session creation, offers an opt-in SessionFactory for advanced consumers, and provides small ergonomic helpers to reduce boilerplate when consuming streaming endpoints. Changes: 1) core/auth: add session_factory.go with SessionFactory interface, RegisterCredentialProvider, and a default DelegatingSessionFactory that composes existing token caches; 2) stream: add stream_reader.go and pull_iterator.go with simple buffering and context-aware cancelation hooks; 3) retry: extract common retry profiles into retry/presets.go and wire the adaptive backoff preset to the SessionFactory; 4) telemetry: add cred_events interface and a small hook in session_factory to emit telemetry tags for lease/refresh/fail events; 5) examples: add examples/session_fanout and examples/stream_reader_usage in the repo root demonstrating multi-connector setups; 6) docs: update SDK CHANGELOG and docs/auth.md to describe SessionFactory usage and migration notes; 7) tests: add unit tests for factory composition, stream cancellation, and a small integration test using the local mock auth server. Commits: c3f5a9b Add SessionFactory interface and default delegating implementation; b2a1d46 StreamReader and PullIterator helpers with buffering; 5d7e0c3 Extract retry presets and wire into factory; 9a4f8b1 Add telemetry hooks and tests; e6c3af2 Docs and examples; 7f2b9d0 Fix lint/test failures after reviewer feedback. Files changed (high level): core/auth/session_factory.go, core/auth/delegating_factory.go, stream/stream_reader.go, stream/pull_iterator.go, retry/presets.go, telemetry/cred_hooks.go, examples/session_fanout/main.go, examples/stream_reader_usage/README.md, docs/auth.md, tests/session_factory_test.go, tests/stream_reader_test.go, go.mod, go.sum. Migration notes: SessionFactory is optional and default behavior remains unchanged for existing consumers; to opt-in to advanced orchestration, instantiate your own SessionFactory and pass it to NewClientWithOptions or set REDWOOD_SESSION_FACTORY env to the factory name. Telemetry hooks are nil by default; SDK will not emit cred events unless a hook is registered. Review conversation snapshot: Reviewer Maya Chen: "Nice consolidation; two asks: add a small e2e verifying the retry preset actually reduces refresh frequency under flakey auth, and can you make the StreamReader buffer configurable?" Author (Liam Ortiz): "Added an integration test using the local mock auth server and exposed BufferSize option on StreamReader, default remains 64KB. Thanks for the pointers." Reviewer Arjun Patel: "Please drop the public NewSessionFactory function and prefer constructor NewDelegatingFactory to avoid export churn." Author: "Switched to NewDelegatingFactory and added a deprecated comment on the removed symbol for the next minor release notes." Reviewer Sofia Martinez: "CI failed lint on first run due to a mixed import grouping and a race in stream tests." Author: "Fixed imports and added a short sleep+retry in flaky test to make it deterministic; flagged a follow-up to rework the test harness (ENG-9201)." CI: First run reported lint fail and one flaky test failure, rerun succeeded. QA & rollout: Manual smoke tested with py/ts example harness to validate session handoff parity. Added a small backwards compatibility test ensuring old behavior unchanged if no factory provided. Performance: microbenchmarks show negligible overhead for default factory (~0.5% latency at 95th p99 of small token refresh scenarios), and stream helper reduces user code complexity based on internal ergonomics review. Risks and mitigations: exposing SessionFactory could encourage custom implementations; guidance in docs recommends composing DelegatingFactory and using provided retry presets. Follow-ups: 1) implement credential warmup hooks in Python/TS SDKs to match Go factory semantics (tracked ENG-9182), 2) add an opt-in telemetry aggregator for cred events in Console pipeline (ENG-9201). Merge: Squash-merged after approvals from all reviewers, CI green. Additional metadata: small version bump in go.mod to v1.5.0-beta.Notes: kept description compact and single-line for PR export compatibility.
notes: This file models a merged SDK PR that coordinates auth/retry/stream ergonomics across languages and is intentionally focused on Go with follow-ups for Py/TS parity.
